content.comment_body: I am experiencing the same issue. Could someone please share how they resolved it?
Tengo el mismo problema, ¿puedes ayudarme? ¿Cómo lo solucionaste?

I'm having trouble sending emails using the [product_name] module. The signal for SMS is good and those messages are sent successfully, but emails fail. I receive an error each time. I'm not sure if this is due to my email provider, since I read that Gmail is restricting third-party app access. I’ve tried changing the port and various settings, but the issue continues. The error mentions: "e-mail failed. Last reply from server 0. Internal error identifier: 7. Number of attempts: 1".

Does the [product_name] module send emails only via wireless (LTE), or is it possible to use a local network email server? I found out local NTP servers can't be used, even though we have several onsite; instead, wireless data and a phone connection must be enabled. Is email similar?

analysis.insight_summary: Users continue to have difficulties sending emails with the [product_name] module, even though SMS functions correctly and the signal strength is suitable. An error message occurs when attempting to send an email. There is confusion about whether this stems from blocked access by email providers such as Gmail, or from improper configuration settings. Users are also unsure if wireless (LTE) is required for email functionality, or if local server options are available, reflecting a need for clearer instructions and documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want reliable email sending from the [product_name] module. They expect support for popular email providers as well as local email servers, and seek clear, accessible configuration guidance.
